assets.name: wood
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating base-color texture for the wooden arch and counter of a warm European station ticket office in a polished stylized 3D board game. Generate a single flat square material swatch, edge-to-edge. Natural medium-dark warm walnut brown, approximate average sRGB #765039. Subtle irregular horizontal flowing wood grain with varied long fibers, occasional very faint broad growth curves; fine matte surface, quiet wear. Grain follows X. This must tile seamlessly on all four edges. Orthographic flat albedo under perfectly even neutral light. No highlights, no shadows, no perspective, no vignette, no boards/plank seams, no frames, no objects, no text, no straight periodic stripes or knots that will dominate repetition. Intended final tile512x512. Low contrast so repetition2x4 remains natural.

assets.name: wood-tile
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: seamless repeating base-color material map for an existing stylized 3D European railway ticket-office menu. Input Image 1 is the edit target, an existing project-generated square flat material swatch. Keep a single square swatch covering the full image, same type of material, matte and seamless on all four edges. Completely even neutral illumination, orthographic flat albedo. No lighting gradient, fixed shadows, highlights, vignette, perspective, objects, labels, frames, fasteners, panels or seams. The final map is downsampled to512x512; keep surface detail small and avoid conspicuous repeated motifs. Primary request: refine the wood to a calmer, finer grain with less red/orange overall color. Use muted walnut-taupe brown, approximate average sRGB #75624B. Preserve the X/horizontal flow of long wood fibers. Make the growth curves less broad and the small fibers irregular, quiet, and slightly worn. No plank borders, knots, straight repetitive stripes or deep creases. Change only surface grain and base-color character; it remains an unlit wood texture.

assets.name: paper-tile
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: flat seamless repeating base-color map of neutral aged cream paper for readable native UI. Input Image 1 is the exact current project-generated paper swatch and is the edit target. Make only one targeted refinement: remove every conspicuously dark dot, dark fleck, dark speck, dark fiber fragment or dark patch from the paper. Replace these with the same surrounding softly varied bright paper fibers. Keep the existing neutral cream/ivory palette, subtle fine fibers, matte age, flat orthographic even neutral illumination and quiet small-scale variation. Aim average sRGB #E7E0CA, with all variation staying very pale, approximate darkest colors no darker than #CFC5AD. No tiny brown or black spots anywhere. Preserve the single square seamless edge-to-edge material; no paper edge, frame, border, fold, tear, object, text, shadow, highlight, vignette, gradient illumination or light direction. Existing geometry/print supplies the edges. The output is downsampled to512x512; dark isolated pixels would lower small native text contrast, so the pale lower bound is the important constraint. Change only the dark contamination; do not add decorative features.
